name: Utility and behaviour
description: Components with little or no appearance whose behaviour is nonetheless part of the contract. A library that omits these forces every product to reinvent them inconsistently.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.anatomy: Content available to assistive technology and hidden from sight.
components.geometry: None
components.semantics: Must not use display:none. Focusable variants become visible when focused, as the skip link does.
components.crystal: The clipping recipe and the focusable variant

components.name: Skip link
components.anatomy: A visually hidden link that appears on focus and jumps to the main region.
components.geometry: Pill; appears at the top-left inset
components.semantics: First focusable element in the document; its target must be focusable
components.crystal: Appearance on focus and placement

components.name: Focus trap
components.anatomy: A region that contains keyboard focus while active.
components.geometry: None
components.semantics: Restores focus to the trigger on release; never traps without a visible, keyboard-reachable exit
components.crystal: The contract only
components.product: The implementation. Use a maintained primitive rather than rebuilding it.

components.name: Transition
components.anatomy: Entry and exit choreography bound to Crystal's timings and easings.
components.geometry: Travel from the motion scale: 5-30px ordinary, up to 50px expressive
components.semantics: Reduced motion removes spatial change and keeps state feedback; transitions are interruptible and never delay a semantic change
components.crystal: Timings, easings, travel limits, the 5s ceiling, reduced-motion behaviour

components.name: Direction provider
components.anatomy: The scope declaring text direction for its subtree.
components.geometry: Mirrors directional geometry: bubble corners, range tracks, drawer edges, drop indicators
components.semantics: Sets a real dir attribute; logical properties do the rest
components.crystal: Which properties are directional and must mirror

components.name: Theme provider
components.anatomy: The scope supplying resolved Crystal tokens to its subtree.
components.geometry: Supplies the content radius and spacing scale
components.semantics: Sets color-scheme so native controls and scrollbars match; respects the system preference when set to system
components.crystal: Token resolution, mode switching, preference persistence, reduced-effect handling
components.product: Which palette, and where preferences are stored

components.name: Reduced effects
components.anatomy: The scope that replaces translucency and diffusion with solid equivalents.
components.material: Solid surfaces replacing every translucent fill; hierarchy preserved by tone and contour
components.geometry: Unchanged. Shapes, silhouettes and spacing never change with effects.
components.semantics: Honours prefers-reduced-transparency and forced-colors, and an explicit product preference
components.crystal: Every material's fallback and the guarantee that hierarchy survives
components.product: Exposing the preference and respecting the system setting
components.note: A compliant fallback never excuses an inaccessible default. Both presentations must pass.

components.name: Resizable region
components.anatomy: A region whose size the person controls, with a visible grab handle.
components.material: Resin handle on the region's own surface
components.geometry: Handle meets 44px even when the visible grip is narrower
components.semantics: role=separator with aria-valuenow and arrow-key resizing. Pointer dragging is never the only route.
components.crystal: Handle treatment, bound states and the settle after a size change
components.note: Layout settles after a measured size change; focus and hover states never animate.

components.name: Watermark
components.anatomy: A repeating mark layered over content.
components.material: None of its own; sits above the content material
components.geometry: Never intercepts pointer events.
components.semantics: aria-hidden; it is decoration and must not be read.
components.crystal: Opacity and contrast so it never obscures text

components.name: QR code
components.anatomy: Renders a value as a scannable code.
components.geometry: Quiet zone preserved; contrast fixed regardless of palette.
components.semantics: Carries a text alternative with the encoded value.
components.crystal: Quiet-zone material, contrast floor, status surfaces
components.product: The value and error correction level

components.name: Click away
components.anatomy: Calls back when a pointer or focus leaves a subtree.
components.geometry: None.
components.semantics: Never the only way to dismiss something; Escape always works too.
components.crystal: That dismissal is also keyboard reachable

components.name: Animate on scroll
components.anatomy: Plays an entry recipe when an element first enters the viewport.
components.geometry: None.
components.semantics: Content is present and readable before the animation runs, never revealed by it.
components.crystal: Which recipes are allowed, the reduced-motion contract
components.product: Thresholds and which elements opt in

components.name: No SSR
components.anatomy: Defers rendering a subtree until the client.
components.geometry: Reserves the final size so nothing shifts on hydration.
components.semantics: Falls back to content, not to emptiness, wherever it can.
components.crystal: That layout does not shift when it resolves

components.name: Global styles
components.anatomy: Applies Crystal's reset and base typography to a document.
components.geometry: Sets the content radius, spacing and reading rhythm as custom properties.
components.semantics: Does not change focus visibility or motion preferences on its own.
components.crystal: The reset, the foundation, the token surface

components.name: Terminal
components.anatomy: A shell emulator.
components.geometry: n/a
components.semantics: n/a
components.crystal: n/a
components.why: A shell emulator is an application, not a design-system component.

components.name: Border beam
components.anatomy: A travelling highlight around a border.
components.geometry: n/a
components.semantics: n/a
components.crystal: n/a
components.why: Crystal specifies edge treatment as the Resin optical rim. A second, unrelated mechanism for a moving border would contradict the material spec, and the ambient tier that would have owned it is deferred.

components.name: Pressable
components.anatomy: Makes any element respond to press across pointer, keyboard and touch.
components.geometry: Enforces the 44px minimum target on whatever it wraps.
components.semantics: Gives its child button semantics unless told otherwise; never swallows keyboard activation.
components.crystal: That the press recipe plays and the focus ring appears

components.name: Focusable
components.anatomy: Makes any element focusable with Crystal's focus ring.
components.geometry: Focus ring at the documented offset.
components.semantics: Adds a tab stop without inventing a role.
components.crystal: The focus recipe

components.name: Drag handle
components.anatomy: Click-and-drag reordering and transfer, by pointer and by keyboard.
components.material: Resin while lifted; Haze drop indicator
components.geometry: Handle is a 44px target; the lifted item keeps its own radius.
components.semantics: Keyboard drag is required, not optional: Enter lifts, arrows move, Enter drops, Escape cancels. Every state is announced.
components.crystal: Lift elevation, drop-indicator material, the motion of the lift and the settle
components.product: What may be dragged where, and what a drop means

components.name: Drop indicator
components.anatomy: Shows where a dragged item will land.
components.geometry: Follows the gap between items rather than covering one.
components.semantics: Announced as the drag moves, so a keyboard drag is followable without sight.
components.crystal: Indicator material and motion

components.name: Virtualizer
components.anatomy: Renders only what is near the viewport, for lists, grids and tables.
components.geometry: Preserves scroll position and item size across recycling.
components.semantics: Keeps aria-setsize and aria-posinset correct, and never drops focus when a focused row recycles.
components.crystal: Scroll surface, focus retention

components.name: Shared element transition
components.anatomy: Carries one element between two views so it reads as the same object.
components.geometry: The element keeps its own geometry through the transition.
components.semantics: Removed entirely under reduced motion; never the only way a view change is signalled.
components.crystal: Which recipes apply, and the reduced-motion contract

components.name: Toolbar
components.anatomy: A grouped set of controls with one tab stop.
components.geometry: Controls are pills; the group reaches 44px.
components.semantics: role="toolbar": one tab stop, arrows move within, orientation declared.
components.crystal: Material, grouping geometry, focus ring

components.name: Router provider
components.anatomy: Hands the library the host application's navigation function.
components.geometry: None.
components.semantics: Every link and navigable item routes through the host router rather than reloading the page.
components.crystal: That navigation is consistent across every component that links
components.product: Which router, and how it navigates

components.name: SSR provider
components.anatomy: Keeps generated ids stable across server and client.
components.geometry: None.
components.semantics: Prevents hydration mismatches in ids that label and describe controls.
components.crystal: That labelling survives hydration
